title: Bind lightweight verification policy to Work Item execution
outOfScope: PR and release verification policy, which remain full gates.
Hosted workflow definitions, branch protection, and provider runner configuration.
Skipping declared Contract verification or weakening failure/Outcome evidence.

sources.reason: Authoritative P1 problem statement and acceptance.
Existing deterministic classifier and monotonic escalation policy.
Current Finish dispatcher that records verification and Outcome evidence.
Defines quality targets and verification entrypoints.
Current public statement that Finish remains a lifecycle entrypoint.

riskAssessment.reason: This changes which local quality command Finish executes and must preserve monotonic escalation and immutable verification evidence.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: The existing classifier, ai-verify projection, Finish dispatcher, and #695 acceptance make the routing boundary testable without unresolved external dependencies.

reasons: Finish routing and verification evidence are repository-governance behavior with a possible false-completion failure mode.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the existing deterministic verification policy govern local Work Item Finish execution, while PR and release remain full gates.

rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。遇到流程问题，要先开工单修正，不要采用临时修补方案。全部原始指摘不得遗漏；最终执行自检、修正循环和发布。

executionDecision.reason: The user granted standing authorization to execute the approved remediation plan through governed Work Items; #695 is the next verified unresolved P1 gate.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record the executable routing boundary before implementation and before archive.

acceptance: For a documentation-only low-risk Work Item, ai-finish derives and records a focused task policy and runs only the registered focused quality path plus mandatory AI checks.
Workflow, installer, dependency, trust, unknown, failed, or explicitly strict Contract changes cannot downgrade and select the full local quality path.
The selected policy, quality command, changed-path inputs, and escalation reasons are recorded in Summary evidence and visible in the active/archived Outcome.
PR and release stages continue to select full verification regardless of a focused local Work Item policy.
Focused and escalation regressions fail before the routing implementation and pass after it; documentation explains the local-only boundary.
guidelines: Treat the verification classifier as the single policy source; do not add a competing ad-hoc Finish classifier.
Never allow a Contract field, CLI flag, or documentation-only classification to lower a workflow, installer, dependency, trust, unknown, failure, PR, or release gate.
Persist evidence-derived routing facts before Outcome generation so a focused check is never represented as PR or release verification.
Keep installed-template behavior and user documentation aligned with the repository runtime.

intent.problem: The repository already classifies task risk and exposes focused/full verification commands, but ai-finish always invokes the same full quality graph. Repeating full project tests for genuinely documentation-only Work Items slows the remediation plan without improving the evidence, while any solution must not weaken PR or release gates.
constraints: Use the existing policy classifier and registered quality targets.
Keep all mandatory AI lifecycle checks and blocked Outcome behavior.
Preserve monotonic escalation for high-risk paths and any prior failure.
Do not alter hosted workflows or branch protection.
intent.rationale: Binding one deterministic policy to local Finish makes proportional verification auditable and efficient, while stage floors continue to protect PR and release decisions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A docs-only active Work Item reaches Finish.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Finish records a light/focused task policy and executes the focused local quality command while required AI checks remain enforced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused ai-finish regression that captures the dispatched registered quality command and Summary/Outcome policy evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A workflow, installer, dependency, trust, unknown, or failed Work Item reaches Finish.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The policy is strict/full and cannot be overridden downward.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Policy and Finish negative regressions for high-risk paths and invalid downgrade requests.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The same docs-only path is evaluated for PR or release.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The stage floor selects full verification, not focused local verification.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Verification-policy unit regressions for PR and release stages.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted governance path is required.

rollbackNote: Revert the Finish routing and policy-evidence changes together; the previous full local quality path remains the safe fallback.
